audit_scope: Primary dataset cards and author papers; no corpus was downloaded, retokenized or deduplicated by this audit. All advertised token counts use source tokenizers and all proposed Aleph quotas require fresh accounting.

datasets.advertised_size: 1.3T tokens; separate score-2 version 5.4T; snapshots through first half of 2025 in v1.4.0
datasets.license: ODC-By-1.0 collection; original web rights remain
datasets.notes: Classifier-selected English pages. Sample across shards/domains. SmolLM-Corpus contains a 220B deduplicated derivative; do not count derivatives as new source diversity.

datasets.advertised_size: 5B documents; more than 3T words; over 1000 languages
datasets.notes: Card directs English users to original FineWeb. Avoid spreading a 20B English research model across all languages. Word counts are not tokenizer counts.

datasets.advertised_size: about 3T tokens across 475M documents and 1733 languages
datasets.notes: Useful source diversity beyond HTML. OCR fidelity, multilingual fragments and duplicated PDF editions require checks.

datasets.advertised_size: 350B+ tokens; 69 languages; English viewer reports 23M rows
datasets.notes: Globally deduplicated; top 10% of educational scores. Card notes graduate technical material was poorly correlated with target benchmarks, so retain a separate technical-paper lane. Language switching remains common.

datasets.advertised_size: 4T tokens; 3B documents
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 collection; card describes research use
datasets.notes: Broad English competence; weaker specialty fit for math/code. Overlap with other Common Crawl corpora must be measured.

datasets.advertised_size: approximately 6T tokens; 150B analysis sample available
datasets.notes: Current card recommends this mix for new from-scratch work; separate dolma3_mix-6T-1025-7B is for reproduction only. Contains web, publications and code, so account for overlap with individually selected components.

datasets.advertised_size: 463.6B source tokens in main-stage table; 1034.4B exposures after sampling weights
datasets.license: Public-domain and source-specific open licenses; preserve per-source metadata
datasets.notes: Prefer per-source filtered versions to retain provenance and choose technical subsets. Includes 67.8B Stack-Edu, 43.3B peS2o, 23.9B StackExchange and 6B arXiv in Comma-tokenizer counts. Aggregate model-training exposures must not be mistaken for unique data.

datasets.advertised_size: v2: 38.97M documents; 42.01B whitespace-separated tokens
datasets.notes: Knowledge cutoff 2023-01-03. Training split includes 8.24M full papers and 30.57M abstracts. Select CS/math/stats and practical methods; supplement recent primary papers separately. Whitespace counts cannot be plugged into the Aleph training budget.

datasets.advertised_size: 125B tokens across 15 languages
datasets.license: Original code licenses; inherited Software Heritage access requirements
datasets.notes: Contains SWH identifiers rather than source bytes. Metadata includes permissive and no_license rows. Fetch permitted files, validate access and record per-file rights. Strong Python/Rust/C++/shell fit depending on available subsets.

datasets.advertised_size: full 67.5TB; dedup 32.1TB; train-full roughly 900B tokens
datasets.license: Original repository licenses; bulk-download agreement with Software Heritage/INRIA required by current card
datasets.notes: Current v2.2.0 removes opt-outs through 2026-07-29. Pin the approved release. More data is unnecessary for this budget; prefer selected educational repositories and associated tests/docs.

datasets.advertised_size: viewer estimates 15.57M rows; exact Aleph token count unmeasured
datasets.license: ODC-By collection; check source code terms
datasets.notes: Three subsets: algorithmic_corpus, synthetic_code_snippet, synthetic_qa. Seeds derive from Stack v2, creating overlap with Stack-Edu and other code corpora. No universal execution-validity claim.

datasets.advertised_size: 3+: 34B tokens / 21.4M docs; 4+: 9.6B / 6.7M; InfiMM 3+: 20.5B; InfiMM 4+: 8.5B
datasets.notes: Prefer 4+ for the initial quota. 4+ is contained in 3+, so summing both double counts. Preserves Markdown/LaTeX and explanatory solutions, not kernel verification.

datasets.advertised_size: 14.7B tokens; 6.3M documents
datasets.notes: Older reproducible baseline with preserved math markup. Overlap with FineMath/Nemotron/MegaMath and StackExchange requires cross-corpus deduplication.

datasets.advertised_size: 371.6B total: 279B web, 28.1B code, 64.5B synthetic
datasets.license: ODC-By collection; source code rights remain
datasets.notes: Former LLM360 location redirects to IFM. Synthetic categories include text/code interleaves. Treat constituent sources and generated derivatives as related records; size alone provides no Aleph-specific advantage.

datasets.advertised_size: card release-wide table: 6.5858T; 3359.8B English CC, 1257.3B synthetic CC among components
datasets.license: NVIDIA Data Agreement for Model Training; gated acceptance
datasets.notes: Release-wide table spans related component datasets; do not label all 6.5858T as this repository's own original web rows. Training-use agreement and generated-data model terms are documented in the card. Avoid adding the same math/code components twice.

datasets.advertised_size: 3plus: 133B / 101.15M docs; 4plus: 52B / 45.10M; related MIND v1 synthetic: 73B / 88.73M
datasets.license: NVIDIA Data Agreement for Model Training; gated acceptance
datasets.notes: Lynx HTML extraction, Phi-4 cleaning, FineMath scoring, MinHash dedup, benchmark decontamination. 8B midtraining evidence does not measure 1B Aleph effects. Prefer 4plus; do not sum contained subsets.

datasets.advertised_size: 39,134,000 samples; source fields count with the Mistral 7B tokenizer
datasets.notes: Generated by Mixtral 8x7B. Convenient short educational text; factual correctness is not mechanically verified. Do not treat all rows as new independent concepts.

datasets.advertised_size: 79,648,272 samples; 41B words; about 75B Pleias-tokenizer tokens
datasets.license: CDLA-Permissive-2.0 collection; CC-BY-SA Wikipedia/Wikibooks seeds retained
datasets.notes: About 20% non-English; 58,698 Wikipedia articles amplified. Filter English/domain/task types. Preserve original seed IDs. Source claims for models below 350M parameters trained on 100B to 200B tokens do not establish 20B Aleph performance.

datasets.advertised_size: 1,354,044,711 samples; 486,367,076,933 completion tokens from 339,347,842 source documents
datasets.notes: SmolLM2-1.7B outputs. IMPORTANT top-level text is original source, generated output is rollout_results[0].text. Teacher hallucinations and truncation documented. Group all rewrites with original for split/dedup; programmatically verify arithmetic/table tasks.

datasets.advertised_size: 306K unique solved problems; 3.2M CoT; 1.7M TIR; 566K GenSelect; 193K additional unsolved problems only
datasets.notes: Card corrects the earlier 540K unique claim. Some expected answers come from model majority vote. Keep extracted-ground-truth/TIR verification distinct. Multiple trajectories per problem are correlated. Strong fit to verifier-backed selection if rechecked.

datasets.advertised_size: 735,255 Python solutions; 28,319 unique questions
datasets.notes: R1 distillation from TACO/APPS/CodeContests/Codeforces. Some questions require joining original datasets. For research-operator behavior prefer version 2's execution and critique fields.

datasets.advertised_size: 1,398,166 Python + 1,174,475 C++ rows; 34,799 unique questions
datasets.notes: R1 generation, QwQ critique, pass_rate in [0, 1] or sentinel -1. -1 means too few tests or validation failure. Question is '-' and must be joined by source/split/index. Judge's right/wrong and measured execution are different supervision signals. Release 2025-05-15.

datasets.advertised_size: 1.2M rows; author-reported pipeline of approximately 75K sampled questions with 16 answers each (paper Figure 4); ~59.8GB uncompressed card bytes
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 collection; preserve seed source metadata
datasets.notes: 850K math, 250K code, 100K science rows, QwQ-32B annotations. Approximate 75K sampled-question figure is explicitly reported in Figure 4, not inferred by dividing rows by 16. Released root count remains unaudited. Evidence is 7B posttraining; long traces can exceed the Aleph 4K window. Retain complete bounded task units rather than blind truncation.

additional_sources.claim: Figure explicitly shows 75k -> X16 -> 1.2M; preceding domain counts are rounded 53k math, 16k code, 6k science. These are author-reported pipeline counts; this audit has not counted distinct released question strings.

additional_sources.location: OpenThoughts3 Data Curation and Scaling Recipe, steps 4 and 5
additional_sources.claim: Downsample to 75k questions; annotate each question 16x with QwQ-32B.

datasets.advertised_size: 225,129 all; 93,733 default; 131,396 extended; 2 to 4 generated traces per problem
datasets.notes: Most evaluated with MathVerify; 12% Llama judge. At least one correct answer per problem does not mean every trace is correct. Match the correctness field by trace index. Authors report default outperformed extended SFT. Long 16K generation limit affects 4K packing.

datasets.role: research reasoning trajectory reference (mathematical algorithm improvement)
datasets.advertised_size: 18 PDF manuscripts, one public mathematical discovery family; no token count measured
datasets.license: No explicit repository license observed; reference metadata only pending permission
datasets.notes: MIC-01 manifest: training/data/research_curricula/dlmst_mic01.json. Ten intermediate manuscripts, seven optimal variants, one consolidated final paper. Group all variants and derivatives under one lineage. Do not copy source bytes, allocate tokens, or include in train/eval corpora until rights and evidence gates clear. Original trajectory is public and contaminated for discovery evaluation.

source_revision_note: Dataset cards checked on the audit date; data-file revisions must be pinned at intake.
